name: Frecuencia de Voz Pasiva
description: Analiza the ratio and distribución of voz pasiva constructions, que AI text tends to overuse compared to escritura humana.
useCase: Detección de texto generado por IA through systematic overuse of voz pasiva constructions
mechanism: Identifica voz pasiva constructions mediante el análisis de auxiliary verb + past participle patrones and dependency parse structures. Computes the passive-to-active ratio per paragraph and its varianza. generado por IA text, particularly from instruction-tuned models, tends to use voz pasiva more uniformly than humans, who naturally vary voice usage based on emphasis, stylistic preference, and information structure.
source: Herbold, S. et al. (2023) - A Large-Scale Comparison of Human-Written Versus ChatGPT-Generated Essays, Scientific Reports
algorithm: Dependency Parse Voice Detection + Ratio Analysis + Variance Measurement
parameters: Detection method: dependency parse patrones, Granularity: per-paragraph, Metrics: passive ratio, passive varianza, passive clustering
strengths:
• Captures a known stylistic bias of AI systems
• Easy to compute and interpret
• Works well as part of característica ensemble
• Consistent signal a través de AI models
limitations:
• Low standalone discriminative power
• Academic and scientific text naturally uses voz pasiva
• Modern LLMs can be prompted to avoid voz pasiva
• Language-specific (mainly English)

references.title: Herbold, S. et al. (2023). A Large-Scale Comparison of Human-Written Versus ChatGPT-Generated Essays. Scientific Reports.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
Biber, D. (1988). Variation Across Speech and Writing. Cambridge University Press.
